tools.name: general_task
tools.title: Run general-purpose Antigravity sub-agent task
tools.description: Delegate a general-purpose coding task to the Antigravity (agy) CLI and block until the headless run exits (synchronous; the tool call IS the wait). Defaults: mode accept-edits, effort medium. The result carries the agent's final response, the resumable conversation_id, token usage, denied_actions, and the git-based files_touched/scope_violations audit when cwd is a git repo. Headless runs auto-DENY tool requests that would prompt instead of hanging (surfaced in denied_actions); permission to allow them is granted by the user via permissions.allow rules in their own Antigravity settings.json (e.g. command(<target>)), which this server never edits. File edits inside the task cwd never prompt; set edit_scope so out-of-scope changes are flagged in the audit. auto_approve is the expert full-auto switch (--dangerously-skip-permissions); pair it with sandbox when granting it.

prompt.description: Full, self-contained task description for the sub-agent. Include all needed context and file paths.

conversation_id.description: Existing agy conversation ID to continue/resume instead of starting a new conversation. Returned by previous task results.

cwd.description: Working directory for the delegated task (project the sub-agent operates on). Defaults to the server's cwd.

model.description: Model for the task, e.g. gemini-3.8-flash (pair it with the effort field) or a tier-carrying id such as gemini-3.8-flash-high (see list_models). Never combine a tier-carrying id with a different effort - the agy CLI rejects that combination.

agent.description: Antigravity agent profile to use (see list_agents)

auto_approve.description: Expert switch: pass --dangerously-skip-permissions so headless runs stop auto-denying gated tools. Pair it with sandbox when granting it. Allowed by this server.

sandbox.description: Run the task with Antigravity's terminal sandbox flag enabled (--sandbox)

add_dirs.description: Extra directories to add to the task's workspace (--add-dir, repeatable)

edit_scope.description: Give the sub-agent an edit boundary (files and directories relative to cwd, or absolute). Out-of-scope changes are surfaced in the result's files_touched/scope_violations audit; it is an audit-and-replay control, not a sandbox — the CLI writes files itself.

project.description: Antigravity project ID or name for the task

timeout_ms.description: Idle timeout for the run in ms (0..3600000; 0 disables the idle kill for this run). Resets on every stdout/stderr chunk from the child; kicks in after this much child silence and kills the child (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 5s). Default: 900000 (AGY_MCP_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS).

tools.name: explore_task
tools.title: Run read-only Antigravity exploration task
tools.description: Delegate a fast read-only exploration and diagnosis task to the Antigravity (agy) CLI and block until the headless run exits (synchronous; the tool call IS the wait). Defaults: mode plan (read-only), effort low; the mode preset is fixed, so callers cannot weaken the read-only posture. Produces answers and summaries without modifying files. Returns the same report as general_task, including the git-based files_touched/scope_violations audit. Headless runs auto-DENY tool requests that would prompt instead of hanging (surfaced in denied_actions); permission to allow them is granted by the user via permissions.allow rules in their own Antigravity settings.json (e.g. command(<target>)), which this server never edits. auto_approve is the expert full-auto switch (--dangerously-skip-permissions); pair it with sandbox when granting it.

tools.name: watch_task
tools.title: Watch live or recent task stream transcript
tools.description: Tails a task's live stream transcript. No args = latest run. Call it while a general_task/explore_task is in flight (this or any session) to watch the sub-agent work; the returned 'running' field plus 'modified' tell a live run from an abandoned one.

stream_file.description: Stream transcript to read. Omit for the latest task_<id>.stream in AGY_MCP_STATE_DIR. Accepted forms: an absolute path under AGY_MCP_STATE_DIR, a bare file name like "task_f8870173.stream", or a task id like "task_f8870173" / "f8870173".

tail_lines.description: Number of trailing lines to return (1..2000, default 400; 0 returns the full transcript, hard-capped at 200,000 chars).
